snapshot: Can't read the snapshot of the local Zotero database ({error}), so nothing is added, to avoid duplicates
no_arxiv: arXiv has no paper with this ID
no_crossref: Crossref has no record of this DOI
warn.doi: Couldn't get DOI metadata ({error}); filled in from the venue name in the note
warn.arxiv: Couldn't get arXiv metadata ({error}); the item may have only a title
no_desktop: Can't reach the Zotero desktop app ({error})
no_web: Can't reach the Zotero web service ({error})
key_forbidden: This Zotero key lacks permission: at zotero.org/settings/keys, tick Allow library access and Allow write access for it
busy: The Zotero server is busy. Try again later
web_status: The Zotero web service returned HTTP {status}
collection_gone: The Zotero collection chosen in Settings no longer exists, so this item went to the library root
not_saved: The Zotero desktop app didn't save it (HTTP {status})
warn.not_in_collection: Couldn't put it in the chosen collection; the item is wherever Zotero currently has selected
no_ids: This paper has no DOI, arXiv ID or link, so Zotero can't check it for duplicates. Add a source to the note first
warn.pending: It was saved to Zotero a moment ago and Zotero hasn't written it to its database yet, so it wasn't added again
no_database: The Zotero desktop app is running, but its database wasn't found under the zotero path in studio.toml, so duplicates can't be checked. Nothing was added
not_running: The Zotero desktop app isn't running and no web key is set up
warn.saved_pending: Saved to Zotero, but its item key can't be read yet. It will be recognized automatically later, without adding it again
bad_key: That Zotero item key isn't valid
note_changed: The note was just changed. Please confirm the line to write again
other_link: The note already has a different Zotero link, so nothing was changed
